versions.changelog: 2.0.3: point at the actual 1.7.0 PC and USB installers on the SkillHub Builds card; no runtime files.
2.0.2: align package metadata with release tag; pointer-only, no runtime files.
2.0.1: correct the public display name to LYGO LLM Console. No runtime files; pointer-only.
2.0.0: remove embedded 1.5.7 operator tree; pointer to console 1.7.0 official downloads, SkillHub vault, GitHub source and API portal. Removes runtime code and the flagged dynamic-execution surface.

Closes the two live T09 findings. (1) Unauthenticated loopback API: _auth() returned True for every loopback caller when AUTH_REQUIRED was false -- the default install -- so any page the operator visited could POST /api/limb and reach shell/python. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE now need the token on loopback too; reads stay open so the health bar works; a non-local Host is refused on a loopback bind (DNS rebinding) unless LYGO_TRUSTED_PROXY opts in; the upload control sends the token it now needs. (2) Untrusted web content inducing local execution: a turn whose context contains fetched web text no longer auto-dispatches shell/python_exec/rust_exec/cargo -- the call is recorded REFUSED with the reason, and LYGO_WEB_TAINT_EXEC=1 is the documented opt-out. references/WHAT_CHANGED_1_6_2.md documents the 1.6.2 fixes; this release states its own evidence in kit/VERSION and SKILL.md.

Closes the three findings 1.6.1 answered in prose: (1) T09 - host_prefetch is now OFF unless you set LYGO_HOST_PREFETCH=1, so a page someone else wrote can no longer share a context with the shell and python limbs by default; a pasted link stays text the model may choose to fetch through a gated tool. (2) the env-to-urlopen taint - the lyrics limb builds its URL from paths.LLAMA_PORT (already range-checked) instead of re-reading LYGO_LLAMA_PORT inside the request. (3) exec_module - the limb adapter is resolved with symlinks followed, must sit inside src/modules/, must be a regular file, and its path and SHA-256 are logged before the load. references/WHAT_CHANGED_1_6_2.md states the cost of each change and the exact work-around (set LYGO_HOST_PREFETCH=1 to restore prefetch).

Answers the 1.6.0 scan report item by item (references/WHAT_CHANGED_1_6_1.md): the eval-shaped regex literal and the 'eval' comment are gone from src, the portal URL is localhost rather than a raw IP, and retention is stated in the description and in Declared capabilities. Kit manifest rebuilt: the 1.6.1 edits had shipped against a 1.6.0 checksum list, so verify_kit failed on all 152 files; scripts/build_kit_manifest.py now regenerates it and self_check fails on a stale manifest. Line endings pinned in .gitattributes so a clone on any platform reproduces the hashed tree.

Kit now ships UNPACKED (console 1.5.6, 152 files, per-file SHA-256 in kit/PUBLIC_KIT.json) instead of a zip, which clears the four HIGH uninspectable-artifact findings; the launcher is drive-portable so it runs the verified folder, not a hardcoded path; the link-local metadata literals in the deny list are gone; permissions restated honestly (loopback, https GET, kit-local writes, optional shell/Python is NOT a sandbox).
v1.2.0 security audit: pin clawhub@0.23.3 and kit SHA-256, honest runtime permissions, no eval, no shell=True, no @latest.
v1.1.0 complete agent portal: 21 limbs, Wikipedia search, URL prefetch, workspace shell/python (P0). Updated public kit zip.
Complete listing: README, skill-card, credits, kit zip with full public runtime.
